newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks solidly higher as bonds lend support.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks solidly higher as bonds lend support.

text.p: Wall Street stocks held to solid gains in afternoon activity on Friday, buoyed by a strong performance in the bond marker that drove interest rates to their lowest levels since 1996.

The Dow industrials stood at 7944 in early afternoon, up 57 points for the session and a trace off their session high of 7955. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 10 points to surpass the 1500 level, holding steady at about 1501.
The 30-year U.S. Treasury gained 15/32 to yield 6.53 percent. Bonds got an early boost when the June Producer Price Index dipped 0.1 percent.
The decline in the June PPI marked the sixth consecutive month that wholesale prices fell, a record for the index.
